cases.description: Fetch toolbar opens Outlook settings from calendar, tasks and AI; cancel does not mutate saved values
Monthly summary tag row opens Tags settings from all three views with current tag retained
Update toolbar opens the update dialog, not a settings page; unsupported synthetic updater cannot install
AI setup guidance is translated text in nine locales; Settings then AI reaches provider controls without inference
